title: Ground events in SAT-3's orbital feed, a corner inset, instead of a camera cut; &cuts=dive keeps the dives
context: Owner, 2026-10-13, after the creature-enemies playtest: "we have too many cuts ... replace most instances of the camera cutting the current action to show a Tremor/sinkhole [with] a temporary screen-within-the-screen, like a temporary satellite or gunship view, clearly marked with HUD info and maybe static/CRT lines that it is a video feed", then "I insist on fixing the Camera jump cuts with screen-within-screen to show the sinkholes". His choices: ground events (sinkhole breaches, the back door's rockfall, the rock-wall reveal) become the inset, the story's own scenes keep their cuts, a satellite look, the corner box ~30 % of the width where the TALON monitor sits. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-ground-feed-inset-design.md; branch feed-inset (from pearl-enemies), local.
outcome: src/fx/ground-feed.js opens the corner box as SAT-3 · ORBITAL FEED for a new sinkhole group, the back door's collapse (SEISMIC ALERT · ROCKFALL) and the campaign board's rock opening (SURVEY · ROCK OPENING), for the old dive's length (pre-roll + hold + tail; 12.48 s for the story's sinkhole): static, a top-down view from orbit (north toward the heart), the zoom from a ~25-cell to a ~4-cell frame from the event's pre-roll, held with a slow drift and roll, static, closed; a green-phosphor look with scanlines, grain and a vignette; the HUD: a blinking REC, the target box, GRID (latitude/longitude from the heart), ZOOM, SEISMIC, T+. No camera shot is started, so the main view stays the player's and nothing waiting on !shotActive() is held; it shows under a manned seat or the gunship unless that seat's feed holds the box, waits behind the TALON / MK-9 monitor, the SOL-82 seat or a live story shot and opens after it while its event is within its hold, else is dropped; a new group retargets an open feed; a paused game, a modal, the seat glide and the showcase hide it; quiet breaches stay quiet. The schedule, the timeline, the HUD numbers and the feed camera's pose are pure (src/domain/feed-schedule.js), the knobs GROUND_FEED (src/content/ground-feed.js). It counts as a second view for the Pearl bodies' culling. The render stays on the GPU: the feed camera draws into a render target at 30 Hz with the main pass's world matrices, a shader quad draws the look into the box's rectangle each frame, no bloom, no readback. &cuts=dive restores the dives (breach, back door, the reveal's orbit frame); the reveal keeps its frozen 3.2 s beat either way, its camera held where it was. td-tab: 0 new lines (6141 of 6400), no line over 500 characters. Deviations from the spec are listed in its Deviations section.
alternatives: The story monitor's render path (the scene into the game canvas, drawImage to a 2D canvas, CSS filter functions for the look): built first, measured +7.5 ms mean and p95 31 -> 49 ms headed; at 30 Hz still +5.6 ms and p95 48 ms; dropped for the render target and shader quad (+3.2 ms, p95 37 ms).

Keeping the Pearl bodies culled to the main camera while the feed is up: within noise of culling off (24.4 vs 24.8 ms), so the feed counts as a second view per the spec and bodies emerging show in it.

Replacing the reveal's frozen shot with the feed alone: it would lose the campaign board's frozen beat, the sim's endShot path and the onEnd's repaint and orbit view, and move setView('orbit') to a cut 3.2 s later; kept the shot with a held camera instead.
